title: Brazil Gears Up for 2026 Presidential Election with Lula and Bolsonaro as Main Contenders
detail: Brazil is preparing for its 2026 presidential election with incumbent President Lula and former President Jair Bolsonaro emerging as the main contenders. The election is shaping up to be a rematch of the closely contested 2022 race, with both candidates mobilizing their bases ahead of the October vote.
